summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) for Ps. 16,439,915,799.42 (US$11,144,664 par value) at 99.97% of nominal value, between June 22-26, 2026. The notes were originally issued in July 2024 and April 2025 under its Frequent Issuer framework, maturing July 2026, and will be held in portfolio. This is a routine debt repurchase and liability management transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve M&A, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or other classic special-situations categories. Risk-arb angle: none; standard open-market note buyback with no structural change.
